title: A tame root generates the maximal ideal in an integral-closure tensor factor
statement: Let $B$ be a discrete valuation ring domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with irreducible uniformizer $\pi$, fraction field $K$, and $n>0$ invertible in $B$. Let $E/K$ be a finite Galois field extension [def-weil-field] whose degree [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] divides $n$. Give $E$ the composite $B$-algebra structure through $K$. Put $A=B[t]/(t^n-\pi)$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and $D=E\otimes_B A$. For every maximal ideal $P$ of $D$, set $F=D/P$, give $F$ its $A$-algebra structure by the right tensor inclusion, and put $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(F)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. For every prime ideal $Q$ of $S$ contracting to $(t)$ in $A$, the maximal ideal of $S_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is generated by the structural image of $t$. This statement is entirely about rings and does not assert any identification with a scheme stalk.

proof.text: Use [lem-sbc-dvr-uniformizer-root-algebra] to equip the root algebra A with its domain and DVR structures and m_A=(t). Monicity gives finiteness over B; AdjoinRoot.of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero gives faithfulness. The root equation t^n=pi gives m_B A=m_A^n by mapping principal ideals.

For every maximal tensor quotient F, apply [lem-sbc-dvr-root-tensor-factor-integral-closure-finite] to the finite normal domain A/B and the finite separable extension E/Frac(B), obtaining Module.Finite A (integralClosure A F).

The proved [lem-sbc-dvr-galois-normalization-ramification-dvd] supplies the divisibility by n of both ramification indices and residue degrees at every prime in integralClosure B E above the closed point.

For Q contracting to (t)=m_A, apply [lem-sbc-dvr-tame-tensor-factor-unramified] with the ideal-power identity, divisibility bounds and finite normalization. This gives Algebra.FormallyUnramified A (Localization.AtPrime Q).

The maximal ideal of S_Q contracts to Q in S, hence to m_A in A, so A -> S_Q is local by IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE. Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal identifies m_A S_Q with m_(S_Q). Rewrite m_A=(t) and map the singleton span. This gives exactly the stated ideal equality with the structural image of the root.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_galois_root_factor_uniformizer
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (hn : IsUnit (n : B))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧
      IsGalois (FractionRing B) E ∧ Module.finrank (FractionRing B) E ∣ n) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)
    let D := E ⊗[B] A
    ∀ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    letI := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] D).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    let S := integralClosure A F
    ∀ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    letI := hQ
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = Ideal.span
      {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)} →
    let t := algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      (algebraMap A S
        (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)))
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q) = Ideal.span {t}
